## Описание задачи

Создай V3 artifact package, который содержит ровно один rewritten project file:

`.ai/subprojects/ork_planner/ork_planner_plan_full.md`

Это должен быть новый цельный canonical rewrite, а не patch list и не critique.

### New canonical lifecycle

Новый документ должен жёстко описывать 6 стадий:

1. Planner review
2. First Orc nav pass
3. One battle plan + human approval
4. Remaining local docs system `ork_planner`
5. Fresh tiny docs-only pilot subproject from scratch
6. Repo-level alignment wave

### Exact stage expectations

`Stage 2 — First Orc nav pass`:

- Orc starts only after explicit human command;
- before first real Orc run there is a mandatory `grill-me` gate;
- nav pass creates exactly:
  - `ork_planner_plan_index.md`
  - `ork_planner_navigation.md`
  - `ork_planner_journal.md`
- `ork_planner_plan_index.md` is for agents, not for human readers;
- `plan_full` may be edited only for anchors, quick links, navigation clarity, typo-level fixes.

`Stage 3 — Battle plan`:

- create one file:
  - `ork_planner_battle_plan.md`
- no `plan_active_1`;
- human approves battle plan before further execution.

`Stage 4 — Remaining local docs system`:

- Orc creates all remaining local files of `ork_planner`, except repo-level global files;
- at minimum this means:
  - `ork_planner_readme.md`
  - `ork_planner_status.md`
  - `ork_planner_decisions.md`

`Stage 5 — Fresh tiny docs-only pilot`:

- create a new tiny subproject from scratch;
- run full `Planner -> Orc` process on a very small fast docs-only task;
- this is proof on clean context before repo-level canon changes.

`Stage 6 — Repo-level alignment wave`:

- allowed repo-level scope is fixed:
  - `.ai/rules/codex_role_planner.md`
  - `.ai/rules/codex_role_orc.md`
  - `.ai/rules/codex_orchestrator.md`
  - `.ai/repo_navigation.md`
  - `AGENTS.md`

### Required document shape

Новый rewrite должен сохранить большой operational характер, но пересобрать skeleton под новые решения.

Обязательные смысловые разделы:

1. Title and document purpose
2. Quick navigation
3. Mission of `ork_planner`
4. Non-goals and forbidden drifts
5. Source basis and source authority order
6. Planner role boundaries
7. Planner-owned vs Orc-owned artifacts
8. Canonical artifact model for this pilot
9. Lifecycle overview
10. V1 / V3 / Kilo usage and recommend-or-waive rule
11. Provenance note for first V3 draft
12. First Orc nav pass
13. One battle plan and approval gate
14. Three hard phases of the pilot
15. Remaining local docs completion and human acceptance
16. Fresh tiny docs-only pilot
17. Repo-level alignment wave after fresh proof
18. Session binding and `session != journal`
19. Minimal required blocks for future `plan_index`, `navigation`, `journal`, `battle_plan`, `readme`, `status`, `decisions`
20. Acceptance gates
21. Anchor map

Important:

- no `Unresolved Decisions` section;
- no active package/import lane section;
- no `plan_navigation`;
- no `plan_active_N` canonicalization.

### Depth requirement

Этот документ должен быть большим и подробным.

- Не возвращай короткий outline.
- Не возвращай patch advice.
- Не пытайся только слегка поправить старый текст.
- Пиши цельный новый operational master document.
